description: Values for the NGX Storage FC CSI driver chart for upstream Kubernetes

tag.title: Image tag
tag.description: Rolling development tag used as the fallback when image.digest is empty. Production releases pin image.digest.

digest.title: Immutable image digest
digest.description: Optional sha256 digest. When non-empty the chart renders repository@digest instead of repository:tag.

logLevel.title: Console log level
logLevel.description: Verbosity of the driver console output. File logs remain detailed regardless of this value.

driverNamePrefix.title: Driver name prefix
driverNamePrefix.description: Single label prepended to the CSI driver name and to driver resource names. Empty preserves fc.csi.ngxstorage.com and the fc-csi-ngxstorage resource names; a non-empty prefix produces <prefix>.fc.csi.ngxstorage.com (driver name) and <prefix>-fc-csi-ngxstorage (resource names) so a second driver instance can serve a distinct NGX Storage backend on the same cluster (for example 201 or 205).

nodePlacement.title: Node pod placement
nodePlacement.description: Where the node DaemonSet may run. Use worker for a high-speed backend reachable only from worker NICs, master for control-plane-only placement, or all for the general-purpose backend.

secret.title: Backend Secret
secret.description: Prefer an existing Secret in production. Set create=true only when managing the Secret through Helm.

storageIPs.title: Storage IPs
storageIPs.description: Comma-separated NGX Storage management API IPs. Required when secret.create=true.

poolName.title: Pool name
poolName.description: NGX Storage share pool name. Required when secret.create=true.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: NGX Storage management API key. Required when secret.create=true.

fcTargetNames.title: FC target names
fcTargetNames.description: Comma-separated pre-created FC target names. Required when secret.create=true.

create.title: Create the VolumeSnapshotClass
create.description: When true, the chart installs a VolumeSnapshotClass. The cluster must provide the snapshot CRDs and controller; disable this when the snapshot API is unavailable.

controllerPlacement.title: Controller pod placement
controllerPlacement.description: Where the controller Deployment may run. Use master (default) for control-plane placement, worker for worker-only, or all.

controllerLivenessPort.title: Controller liveness probe port
controllerLivenessPort.description: HTTP port for the controller liveness-probe sidecar. A second driver instance must use a different port.

nodeLivenessPort.title: Node liveness probe port
nodeLivenessPort.description: HTTP port for the node liveness-probe sidecar. A second driver instance in hostNetwork on the same worker must use a different port.

coordination.title: Distributed coordination
coordination.description: Fixed pre-created Kubernetes Lease shard pool used for cross-pod CSI mutation serialization. Changing the shard modulus requires a coordinated migration boundary, not a mixed rolling upgrade.

sidecars.title: CSI sidecar images
sidecars.description: Immutable Quay mirror references for upstream CSI sidecars.
